id: e2f9c3a8-4d7b-4f1e-8c2a-9b3d6e4f5a78
status: experimental
description: Detects retrieval of the second-stage shell script under the Ultralytics repository pinned at attacker-controlled commit d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14 on raw.githubusercontent.com, used in the December 2024 pwn-request supply chain attack.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/ultralytics-ai-pwn-request-supply-chain-attack/
  - https://github.com/ultralytics/actions/security/advisories/GHSA-7x29-qqmq-v6qc
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/12/11
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: 'd8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Defender / IR analyst querying GitHub for the malicious commit to retrieve the script for analysis (must run from a forensics workstation)
level: high
3759.spl: (| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*raw.githubusercontent.com*" AND Web.url="*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14*" by Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.url Web.http_method | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`) | append [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14*" by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3759.datadog: (source:proxy OR source:zscaler OR source:bluecoat OR source:cloudflare OR source:linux.auditd OR source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) (@http.url:*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14* OR @url:*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14* OR @process.command_line:*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14* OR @CommandLine:*d8daa0b26ae0c221aa4a8c20834c4dbfef2a9a14*)

3760.sigma:
title: ImageMagick convert -resize Command Injection via sh -c
id: 8f3c2a1e-9b4d-4c77-a2e1-5d6f7c8b9a01
description: Detects an ImageMagick 'convert ... -resize' command executed through a Unix shell whose command line contains shell metacharacters or secondary commands, indicating command injection through a user-controlled resize/size parameter (Snyk Go command-injection pattern).
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/understanding-go-command-injection-vulnerabilities/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_convert:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'convert'
      - '-resize'
  selection_inject:
    CommandLine|re: '[;&|]|\$\(|\bwget\b|\bcurl\b|\bnc\b|rm\s+-rf|/etc/passwd'
  condition: selection_convert and selection_inject
level: high
3760.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","convert") AND Processes.process="*convert*" AND Processes.process="*-resize*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | regex process="(?i)convert.*-resize.*([;&|`$]|\$\(|\bwget\b|\bcurl\b|\bnc\b|rm\s+-rf|/etc/passwd)" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process count
3760.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.command_line:*convert* @process.command_line:*resize* (@process.command_line:*"rm -rf"* OR @process.command_line:*wget* OR @process.command_line:*curl* OR @process.command_line:*nc* OR @process.command_line:*"/etc/passwd"* OR @process.command_line:*bash*)
3760.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/(sh|bash|dash|convert)$/i
| CommandLine=/convert/i
| CommandLine=/-resize/i
| regex("[;&|`$]|\\bwget\\b|\\bcurl\\b|\\bnc\\b|rm\\s+-rf|/etc/passwd", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, CommandLine], function=count())

3761.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Lottie Player npm package compromised for crypto wallet theft
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("player.js", "player.min.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3761.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Lottie Player npm package compromised for crypto wallet theft ```

    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("player.js","player.min.js"))

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem

3801.sent:
// Article: backdoor activates when sshd chain-loads liblzma.so.5.6.0 / 5.6.1 via libsystemd.
// Path A: Defender XDR Linux EDR image-load telemetry forwarded to Sentinel.
// Path B: auditd PATH records via Syslog connector when DeviceImageLoadEvents is unavailable.
let edr = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessName has "sshd" or ActingProcessName has "systemd"
    | where TargetFileName has_any ("liblzma.so.5.6.0", "liblzma.so.5.6.1")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source="ImFileEvent", Host=DvcHostname, Process=ActingProcessName, Cmd=ActingProcessCommandLine, File=TargetFilePath;
let aud = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Facility in ("auth","authpriv","daemon","user")
    | where ProcessName in~ ("audisp-syslog","audispd","sshd","systemd","auditd")
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("liblzma.so.5.6.0", "liblzma.so.5.6.1")
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("sshd", "systemd")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=HostName, Process=ProcessName, Cmd="", File=SyslogMessage;
union edr, aud
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects execution of the macOS `defaults` CLI reading NSUserDictionaryReplacementItems, the global preference holding keyboard text replacements. 3998.sigma:
title: Dirty Pipe - /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow Modified by Unexpected Process
id: 6b1d2c0e-9a3f-4e21-8c7a-2f1b5d4e0a91
description: Detects modification of the Linux credential store by a process other than the standard account-management utilities, a hallmark of CVE-2022-0847 (Dirty Pipe) exploitation.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/dirty-pipe-vulnerability-cve-2022-0847-containerized-applications/
  - https://wazuh.com/blog/detecting-dirty-pipe-vulnerability-with-wazuh-cve-2022-0847/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1003.008
  - attack.t1222.002
  - attack.t1068
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/passwd'
      - '/usermod'
      - '/useradd'
      - '/userdel'
      - '/chpasswd'
      - '/newusers'
      - '/vipw'
      - '/systemd-sysusers'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Configuration management (Ansible/Puppet/Chef) writing accounts via temp-file rename
level: high
3998.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path IN ("/etc/passwd","/etc/shadow")) (Filesystem.action="modified" OR Filesystem.action="created" OR Filesystem.action="renamed") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.action Filesystem.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where user!="root" AND user!="_apt" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
3998.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\/etc\/(passwd|shadow)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\/(passwd|usermod|useradd|userdel|chpasswd|newusers|vipw|systemd-sysusers)$/i)
| table([@timestamp, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, WrittenBytes])

description: Detects a process running as root whose image resides in /tmp, /var/tmp or /dev/shm - the SUID-backdoor execution stage of CVE-2022-0847 (Dirty Pipe) privilege escalation.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/dirty-pipe-vulnerability-cve-2022-0847-containerized-applications/
  - https://www.sysdig.com/blog/cve-2022-0847-dirty-pipe-sysdig
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1548.001
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1611
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|startswith:
      - '/tmp/'
      - '/var/tmp/'
      - '/dev/shm/'
    User: 'root'
  filter_systemd:
    Image|startswith: '/tmp/systemd-'
  condition: selection and not filter_systemd
falsepositives:
  - Self-extracting installers or AppImages that stage to /tmp
level: high
